origin: Forge-authored original procedural modeling instruction; no third-party geometry or private user examples
purpose: Explicitly teach five original procedural modeling operations and their verified effects; true boolean-welded glass and nacelle sockets remain future work
model_basis: Actual MiniGeometry / GlbWriter code in public Assetwright repo
review_policy: Performance measurements validate execution effects only; no autonomous aesthetic acceptance

techniques.purpose: True welded mesh boundaries and recessed engine sockets with shared topology rather than overlapping volumes
techniques.why: The implemented cockpit deck sculpt and fitted nacelle housing overlap separate meshes; actual shared topology and watertight Boolean or remeshing integration are not yet implemented
geometry_recipe: Construct source-identified cut contours on the hull surface
Remove intersecting faces and insert boundary loops with consistent winding
Bridge or remesh the shared boundaries with smooth normal continuity
Validate manifoldness, zero self-intersection and exterior face normals across the cut
failure_modes: Intersecting closed volumes remain uncut
Booleans create shading pinches or tiny triangles
